name: Takanashi Yurina
source:
Kiseki's mother and Ryuusei's ex-wife.
Her hobby is dollmaking.
She is currently hospitalized at the Malenis Mental Health Center.

"Please be quiet, or the kid will wake up."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=13]official website[/url]]
